d:
The Magic defeated the Kings, 107-100 tonight in Sacramento. Franz Wagner contributed a team-high 33 points to go with 7 rebounds 7 assists and 2 steals, with Anthony Black of the Magic adding an additional 26 points (10-17 FG, 2-5 3P) in the game. Zach LaVine finished with a team-high 31 points along with 6 three pointers for the Kings in the losing effort. The Magic improve their record to 3-7 with the win, while the Kings fall to 1-10 for the season.
